newsitem.title: USA: Ekco Q3 says Q3 revs lower-than-expected.
newsitem.headline: Ekco Q3 says Q3 revs lower-than-expected.

text.p: Ekco Group Inc said on Wednesday that revenues and net income for the third quarter and the year will be lower than analysts' expectations and the prior year's results.
The company expects revenues in the third quarter to be about $80 million and net income to be about $2.0 million, or $0.10 per share, before the effect of certain special charges.

For the 1996 fiscal year, the company expects revenues to be about $275 million and net income to be about $2.5 million, or $0.12 per share, before the effects of certain special charges and the extraordinary charge related to the senior note offering recorded in the first quarter of 1996.
The company expects to announce actual results for the third quarter during the week of October 21.
The company said that revenue in the third quarter was hurt principally by lower-than-expected sales to the company's smaller customers.
This was attributable largely to transition issues associated with the consolidation of its plastics, cleaning products and housewares units into a single operating entity during the past year.

While sales to the company's largest accounts have continued to grow in 1996 and are expected to be higher than in 1995, the company said, sales to smaller customers have lagged behind last year's level.
